test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Which of the following sentence is in the past continuous tense?

options.text: They were watching TV all evening.
They would have watched TV all evening.
They shall be watching TV all evening

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. They were watching TV all evening.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Past continuous tense indicates an action that was ongoing at a particular time in the past.
 
• The structure of the past continuous tense is **Subject + was/were + Verb(ing) + Object.**
 
• "They were watching TV all evening" correctly uses the past continuous tense.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *"They were watching TV all evening."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: "They would have watched TV all evening" is in the past perfect conditional tense, not past continuous.
 
• Option 3: "They watched TV all evening" is in the simple past tense, not past continuous.
 
• Option 4: "They shall be watching TV all evening" is in the future continuous tense, not past continuous.
